race.description: Alcoa - Pinjarra Alumina Refinery 3yo Mdn Ms Pace
race.comment: IDEAL TITAN NZ (5) was in the money on debut two runs ago then was about the mark again last time over 2190m at Northam, finishing 13 metres from the winner in second. Facing a tougher assignment but he is capable of running another bold race. CALZAGHE NZ (8) might need a few good breaks from an awkward draw but is a likely improver in his second WA appearance. LITTLE MISS HOTTIE (3) placed in a trial here and draws well so look for a debut showing. STORYBOOK HERO (1) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish third at this track. May be competitive again from this draw.
